To improve the benchmark quality, ensure that the shared public facts (S1-S5) provide sufficient context so that a lone agent can at least identify which specific information is missing, or increase the density of public information that points toward the necessity of the private facts (PF1-PF4). Specifically, ensure that the 'why' for each PF is clearly contrasted against the baseline provided in the shared facts.
